mapper.select: , matched AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM records r ) SELECT 'total' AS dimension,'all' AS code,count(*) AS count,min(occurred_at)::text AS first_date, max(occurred_at)::text AS last_date,max(source_updated_at)::text AS latest_sync FROM matched UNION ALL SELECT d.dimension,d.code,count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('city',r.city_code),('zone',coalesce(r.zone::text,'missing')), ('status',coalesce(r.status::text,'missing')),('severity',coalesce(r.severity::text,'missing')), ('damageType',coalesce(r.damage_type::text,'missing')),('maintenanceType',coalesce(r.maintenance_type::text,'missing')), ('month',coalesce(to_char(r.occurred_at,'YYYY-MM'),'missing')), ('resultProvided',CASE WHEN nullif(trim(r.result),'') IS NULL THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END) ) d(dimension,code) GROUP BY d.dimension,d.code ORDER BY dimension,code
SELECT ,NULL::bigint AS matching_total FROM records r ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT 10
